---
title: "Run all analyses in one go"
author: "Luis Sebastian Galán, Laura Grenaa Jensen, Taniya Dey and hota Kanishka Rao"
format: html
---

We use this file to run the whole project in one go. First, we load, clean and prepare the data. Then we describe the dataset and run our two analyses.

```{r}
here::i_am("R/00_all.qmd")

# List the files in the order we want to run them.
project_files <- c(
  "01_load.qmd",
  "02_clean.qmd",
  "03_augment.qmd",
  "04_describe.qmd",
  "05_analysis_1.qmd",
  "05_analysis_2.qmd"
)

# Render each file and wait for it to finish before starting the next.
purrr::walk(project_files, function(project_file) {
  quarto::quarto_render(
    input = here::here("R", project_file),
    quarto_args = c("--output-dir", "../results"),
    as_job = FALSE
  )
})
```
